@kiteboarderdoge @ChurchOfPumps Fiat onramp is coming as well as more liquidity. The p2p nature of the exchange means we need to build custom tooling for liquidity providers. We can't just copy a AMM like Uniswap because dogecoin is a utxo-based chain.
